scenes.headline: Sort
scenes.subtitle: Ordering rows by one or more columns.
scenes.narration: Sorting arranges the rows of a DataFrame in order by one or more columns, ascending or descending.

scenes.headline: Sort essentials
items: orderBy and sort both order the rows
Use asc and desc to control direction per column
Global sort triggers a shuffle across partitions
sortWithinPartitions orders locally, avoiding a full shuffle
scenes.narration: Both orderBy and sort order the rows, and you control direction per column with asc and desc. A global sort triggers a shuffle across partitions, while sortWithinPartitions orders locally and avoids that full shuffle.

scenes.headline: Sorting by multiple columns
scenes.narration: We order employees first by department ascending, then by salary descending within each department. Passing column expressions with asc and desc lets us mix sort directions across the different columns cleanly.

scenes.text: A global orderBy shuffles everything — sort only when the final output truly needs it.
scenes.narration: A global orderBy shuffles the entire dataset, so apply it only when the final output genuinely needs to be ordered.
